    S=shapes(I); H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    items=[(c,k,cells,any(I[y][x]!=O[y][x] for y,x in cells)) for c,ss in S.items() if c!=bg for k,cells in enumerate(ss)]

            print('  twin color',c,'centroid',(round(cen[0],1),round(cen[1],1)),'dL',round(dL,2),'CHANGED' if ch else '')
